<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: Petshop Pragma Export
 * Description: Automatinis Pragma buhalterines sistemos eksportas
 * Version: 1.0.0
 */

defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

// ================================================================
// 1. SCHEDULED TASK - 5ta einamojo menesio diena
// ================================================================
add_action( 'init', function() {
    if ( ! wp_next_scheduled( 'petshop_pragma_monthly_export' ) ) {
        // Suplanuojame kitą 5-ą dienos paleidimą
        $next_run = petshop_pragma_next_run_time();
        wp_schedule_single_event( $next_run, 'petshop_pragma_monthly_export' );
    }
});

function petshop_pragma_next_run_time() {
    $now   = current_time( 'timestamp' );
    $year  = (int) date( 'Y', $now );
    $month = (int) date( 'n', $now );
    $day   = (int) date( 'j', $now );

    if ( $day >= 5 ) {
        // Jau praleidome šio mėnesio 5-ą — einame į kitą mėnesį
        $month++;
        if ( $month > 12 ) { $month = 1; $year++; }
    }

    return mktime( 8, 0, 0, $month, 5, $year ); // 08:00 LT
}

add_action( 'petshop_pragma_monthly_export', function() {
    // SAUGIKLIS: siusti tik kai production mode ijungtas
    if ( ! get_option( 'petshop_pragma_production_mode', false ) ) {
        petshop_pragma_log( 'Automatinis eksportas PRALEISTAS — production mode isjungtas' );
        wp_schedule_single_event( petshop_pragma_next_run_time(), 'petshop_pragma_monthly_export' );
        return;
